from __future__ import annotations

from collections.abc import Mapping, Sequence

from pydantic import BaseModel, Field, constr


class Pet(BaseModel):
    name: str = Field(..., title='Name')


class Owner(BaseModel):
    pets: Sequence[Pet] = Field(..., title='Pets')
    nicknames: Sequence[constr(max_length=3)] = Field(..., title='Nicknames')
    ids: set[int] = Field(..., title='Ids')
    frozen_ids: frozenset[int] = Field(..., title='Frozen Ids')
    by_name: Mapping[str, Pet] = Field(..., title='By Name')
    scores: Sequence[int] = Field(..., title='Scores')
